description: This PHP script handles AJAX requests to enable or disable LAN ports related to hardware configuration, specifically for multi-LAN and security bridge settings. It includes session validation, parameter fetching, and backend configuration updates.

methods.name: getParaValues
methods.description: Fetches parameter values from backend configuration based on object name and parameter list.

methods.name: setStr
methods.description: Sets a string value to a specified backend configuration path.
